## Projects

Figures below are from each project's own tests, benchmarks and docs (re-verified against the code on 2026-11-05).

- CodeGlyph (live as Codebase Intel): cited code-intelligence SaaS for any public GitHub repo, 30+ users. Repos up to 10,000 files; hybrid FTS5 + vector retrieval with reciprocal-rank fusion and an import graph (62/64 retrieval eval targets); every file:line citation checked against the index (131/133 correct in a blind A/B); an edit agent opens multi-file pull requests after tree-sitter syntax checks in 13 languages. 1,428 backend, 389 frontend unit and 86 Playwright tests. Python, FastAPI, React, Turso, NVIDIA Nemotron. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/codeglyph
- Prepvia (live as InterviewAI): voice-first AI mock-interview platform, 100+ users and 50+ completed interviews. Next.js 16 app streaming NDJSON over HTTP; Silero VAD, speculative Groq Whisper STT, hedged NVIDIA Nemotron calls, Edge neural TTS. Median voice turn 1.88 s; 50 concurrent candidates, 450 turns, 0 errors; LLM-judge quality 4.78/5. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/prepvia
- ReleaseLens: release-intelligence platform, built and verified locally, not yet deployed. 360K+ CI builds (2.64M job rows, 1,300 projects) ingested with Airflow and dbt onto S3-compatible storage (MinIO); XGBoost trained on 128,819 Java builds across 402 projects (PR-AUC 0.811, ROC-AUC 0.881) predicts CI build-failure risk with SHAP reasons, p95 40 ms; OpenTelemetry traces through Kafka name a regression's probable origin and blast radius. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/releaselens
- MandateGraph (authorization and security harness for AI agents; in progress, repo not public yet): https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/mandategraph
- twtdash: local-first browser extension that turns X bookmarks into a searchable library, sorted on-device into 18 categories, with a UI in English, Hindi and 8 more Indian languages; 42 ms per keystroke at 10,000 posts; 437 unit tests, 339 end-to-end checks, 2,700 fuzzed payloads. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/twtdash
- Seamly: in-browser cricket bowling coach (YOLO11 pose on ONNX Runtime Web, MotionBERT 3D lifting, two-camera fusion, pace without radar); release within one frame on 7 of 8 real clips; 364 Python-parity tests. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/seamly
- Settle: PWA and Android app to split bills in India and get paid back over UPI, in 8 languages; AI bill reading, exact paise maths, native Android auto-settle; 5,081 unit and component tests and 364 end-to-end journeys. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/settle
- StrideCircle: Strava group challenges with effort-weighted scoring, SQL-view leaderboards and Groq AI coaching. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/stridecircle
- TraininGenie: production website for a corporate-training company, static Next.js 16 with JSON-LD, llms.txt and IndexNow; sole developer. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/trainingenie
- ChaosAI: agentic chaos-engineering tool (LangGraph) built for the Bosch (BGSW) hackathon, Top 5; bounded faults against OpenMeter with verified rollback. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/chaosai
- Document QA: local RAG over scanned PDFs with hybrid FAISS + BM25 retrieval and an LLM grounding check, on Ollama. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/rag-document-qa
- IPL Match Predictor: Random Forest over 1,095 IPL matches (2008–2024) served by a Flask API. https://ayushmanchakraborty.vercel.app/projects/ipl-match-predictor
